title: Pair-Free Coarse-to-Real Video Generation via Real-to-Coarse Image Supervision
title_zh: 通过真实到粗糙的图像监督实现无配对的粗糙到真实视频生成

paragraphs.en: 提出利用真实到粗糙图像对训练DINO-R2C与C2R#模型，实现无需配对视频的粗糙到真实视频生成。 Coarse-to-real (C2R) video generation converts coarse animation, simulation, or game-rendered videos into photorealistic videos while preserving scene layout, camera motion, and dynamics. Training such models requires aligned (coarse, realistic) video pairs, which are expensive to create and confine prior systems to narrow synthetic domains. We exploit a simple asymmetry: paired videos are hard to obtain, but paired real-to-coarse images are easy to construct with existing editing and 3D reconstruction tools. Using these image pairs, we train the DINO-R2C model to transfer realistic images to coarse images in DINO feature space, and apply it frame-wise to ordinary real videos to synthesize pseudo-coarse videos. The C2R# model then learns to generate each real video from its pseudo-coarse counterpart, free from needing (coarse, realistic) video pairs. At inference, the DINO-R2C model is discarded and actual coarse videos drive the C2R# model directly. Thus, our pair-free training scales with any real-video corpora rather than with paired synthetic videos. We will release the model and project webpage at https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/.
paragraphs.zh: 提出利用真实到粗糙图像对训练DINO-R2C与C2R#模型，实现无需配对视频的粗糙到真实视频生成。粗糙到真实（C2R）视频生成是将粗糙的动画、仿真或游戏渲染视频转换为照片级真实感视频，同时保留场景布局、相机运动和动态效果。 训练此类模型需要对齐的（粗糙、真实感）视频对，其制作成本高昂，且使已有系统局限于狭窄的合成领域。 我们利用一个简单的不对称性：配对视频难以获取，但借助现有的编辑与三维重建工具，配对的真实到粗糙图像很容易构建。 利用这些图像对，我们训练DINO-R2C模型，在DINO特征空间中将真实感图像转换为粗糙图像，并将其逐帧应用于普通真实视频以合成伪粗糙视频。 然后训练C2R#模型从伪粗糙视频生成对应的真实视频，无需依赖（粗糙、真实感）视频对。 在推理阶段，DINO-R2C模型被弃用，由实际的粗糙视频直接驱动C2R#模型。 因此，我们的无配对训练可以随任意真实视频语料库扩展，而不依赖于配对的合成视频。 我们将在 https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/ 发布模型与项目网页。
